document.abstract: Welcome to the SMPTE's 2012 Annual Progress Report! The past year has been unfortunately fraught with further economic struggles around the globe. But despite those woes, there have been some small, important changes in the entertainment industry that provide guidance to the direction that the Society must take to be responsive to the industry needs.
